title: Spanish Paella with Danmuji
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, this paella recipe incorporates the spicy and sweet flavors of danmuji for a unique and delicious meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the danmuji, tomato, paprika, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add the paella rice and stir to coat with the vegetables and spices.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
